items.title: Craving in Three Realms, and Grasping's Fourfold Object, Agent, and Purpose

items.zh: 欲愛云何？謂欲界諸行為緣所生，於欲界行染污希求，由此能生欲界苦果。色愛云何？謂色界諸行為緣所生，於色界行染污希求，由此能生色界苦果。無色愛云何？謂無色界諸行為緣所生，於無色界行染污希求，由此能生無色界苦果。
items.en: What is desire-realm craving? It arises conditioned by desire-realm formations, a defiled longing for desire-realm formations, and by this it produces the suffering-result of the desire realm. What is form-realm craving? It arises conditioned by form-realm formations, a defiled longing for form-realm formations, and by this it produces the suffering-result of the form realm. What is formless-realm craving? It arises conditioned by formless-realm formations, a defiled longing for formless-realm formations, and by this it produces the suffering-result of the formless realm.

items.zh: 欲取云何？謂於諸欲所有欲貪。見取云何？謂除薩迦耶見，於所餘見所有欲貪。戒禁取云何？謂於邪願所起戒禁所有欲貪。我語取云何？謂於薩迦耶見所有欲貪。初唯能生欲界苦果，餘三通生三界苦果。
items.en: What is the grasping of sensory desire? Craving directed at the objects of desire. What is the grasping of views? Craving directed at every view apart from the view of a perishable self. What is the grasping of precepts and vows? Craving directed at the precepts and vows arisen from a wrongly directed aspiration. What is the grasping of self-doctrine? Craving directed at the view of a perishable self itself. The first alone produces suffering only in the desire realm; the remaining three, in common, produce suffering throughout all three realms.

items.title: Becoming: Seven Angles on a Single Life, Multiplied Across Three Realms

items.zh: 欲有云何？謂欲界前時有、業有、死有、中有、生有，及那落迦、傍生、餓鬼、人、天有，總說名欲有。此復由先所作諸行煩惱攝受之所熏發。色有云何？謂除那落迦、傍生、餓鬼、人有，所餘是色有應知。無色有云何？謂復除中有，所餘是無色有應知。
items.en: What is desire-realm becoming? The ordinary interval of a life, the karma that projects it, the moment of death, the intermediate state, and the moment of rebirth, together with hell, animal, ghost, human, and god existence — all this, taken together, is called desire-realm becoming, brought about entirely through the perfuming force of past formations gathered up by affliction. What is form-realm becoming? Every one of these apart from hell, animal, ghost, and human existence. What is formless-realm becoming? The same again, further apart from the intermediate state.

items.zh: 問：依何義故建立七有，所謂那落迦、傍生、餓鬼、人、天有，業有、中有？答：依三種所作故。一、能引有，謂一；二、趣有有，謂一；三、受用果有，謂五。
items.en: Question: On what basis are these seven kinds of becoming established — hell, animal, ghost, human, and god existence, karmic becoming, and the intermediate state? Answer: On the basis of three distinct functions. First, the projecting function, belonging to karmic becoming alone. Second, the function of heading towards a destiny, belonging to the intermediate state alone. Third, the function of actually experiencing a result, belonging to the five destinies.

items.title: Birth's Own Ten Angles, from the First Instant in the Womb to a Sustained Life-Faculty

items.zh: 生云何？謂於胎、卵二生，初託生時。等生云何？謂即於彼身分圓滿，仍未出時。趣云何？謂從彼出。起云何？謂出已增長。出現云何？謂於濕、化二生，身分頓起。
items.en: What is birth? For womb-birth and egg-birth, the very first instant of conception. What is equal-growth? The stage when the body is fully formed yet has not yet emerged. What is emergence? The actual coming forth from womb or egg. What is arising? Growth continuing after that emergence. What is manifestation? For moisture-birth and spontaneous birth, the body appearing whole and complete all at once.

items.zh: 蘊得云何？謂即於彼諸生位中五取蘊轉。界得云何？謂即彼諸蘊因緣所攝性。處得云何？謂即彼諸蘊餘緣所攝性。諸蘊生起云何？謂即彼諸蘊日日飲食之所資長。命根出現云何？謂即彼諸蘊餘壽力故得相續住。
items.en: What is the attainment of the aggregates? The five aggregates of clinging actually occurring at every one of these stages of birth. What is the attainment of their causal element? The very same aggregates as included within their causal condition. What is the attainment of their basis? The very same aggregates as included within their remaining conditions. What is the arising of the aggregates? These same aggregates sustained and nourished, day after day, by food. What is the manifestation of the life-faculty? These same aggregates continuing on, sustained by the remaining power of their allotted lifespan.

items.zh: 此生支略義者，謂若生自性、若生處位、若所生、若因緣所攝、若任持所引、若俱生依持，是名略義。
items.en: The essential meaning of this link, birth, is this: its own essential nature, the stages of its process, what it actually produces, what is included within its causes and conditions, what sustains and draws it onward, and what accompanies and supports it — this is its essential meaning.

items.title: Old Age in Seventeen Unsparing Details, from Trembling Limbs to a Failing Memory

items.zh: 衰云何？謂依止劣故，令彼掉動。老云何？謂髮色衰變。襵云何？謂皮膚緩皺。熟云何？謂火力衰減，無復勢力受用欲塵。氣力損壞云何？謂性多疾病故，無有勢力能作事業。黑黶間身云何？謂黯黑出現，損其容色。
items.en: What is frailty? The faculties, grown weak, begin to tremble. What is ageing? The hair changes and loses its colour. What is wrinkling? The skin grows slack and creased. What is a failing constitution? Bodily warmth declines, leaving no strength left to enjoy the objects of desire. What is loss of vigour? Frequent illness leaves no strength left to accomplish anything. What is blotched skin? Dark spots appear, marring the complexion.

items.zh: 身脊傴曲、喘息奔急云何？謂行步威儀身形所顯，由此發起極重喘嗽。形貌僂前云何？謂坐威儀位，身首低曲。憑據杖策云何？謂住威儀位，依杖力而住。昏昧云何？謂臥威儀位，數重睡眠。羸劣云何？謂即於此位，無力速覺。
items.en: What is a stooped spine and laboured breath? The bent form and hurried gait visible in walking, giving rise to heavy panting and coughing. What is a bowed posture? The head and body bent low while seated. What is leaning on a staff? Needing a cane's support simply to stand. What is a clouded mind? Falling repeatedly into heavy sleep while lying down. What is feebleness? In this same state, being unable to wake quickly.

items.zh: 損減云何？謂念慧衰退。衰退云何？謂念慧劣故，至於善法不能現行。諸根耄熟云何？謂身體尫羸。功用破壞云何？謂彼於境不復明利。諸行朽故云何？謂彼於後將欲終時。其形腐敗云何？謂壽量將盡，身形臨壞，於諸事業無復功能。
items.en: What is diminishment? Mindfulness and wisdom declining. What is decline itself? Mindfulness and wisdom so weakened that wholesome practice can no longer even be undertaken. What is the faculties' full decrepitude? The body grown utterly frail. What is broken function? The faculties no longer meeting their objects with any clarity or keenness. What is decayed formation? Being close to the very end of life. What is bodily decay? The lifespan nearly spent, the body on the verge of collapse, capable of nothing further at all.

items.zh: 此老略義者，謂依止變壞、鬚髮變壞、充悅變壞、火力變壞、無病變壞、色相變壞、威儀變壞、無色諸根變壞、有色諸根變壞、時分已過、壽量將盡，略義應知。
items.en: The essential meaning of old age is this: decay of one's own support, decay of hair, decay of fullness, decay of bodily warmth, decay of health, decay of complexion, decay of bearing, decay of the formless faculties, decay of the formed faculties, time having passed, and the lifespan nearing its end — this is its essential meaning.

items.zh: 彼彼有情云何？謂那落迦等。有情種類云何？謂即彼一切。

items.title: Death in Nine Precise Stages, and the Twelve Links' Differences Close Entirely

items.zh: 終云何？謂諸有情離解支節而死。盡云何？謂諸有情由解支節而死。壞云何？謂識離身。沒云何？謂諸色根滅。捨壽云何？謂氣將盡位。捨煖云何？謂不動位。
items.en: What is ending? Dying free of the pain of the joints coming apart. What is expiring? Dying through the joints actually coming apart. What is dissolution? Consciousness departing the body. What is failing? The physical faculties ceasing. What is the relinquishing of breath? The stage when the breath is about to be entirely spent. What is the relinquishing of warmth? The stage of complete stillness.

items.zh: 棄捨諸蘊命根謝滅云何？謂時死。死云何？謂遇橫緣，非時而死。時運盡云何？謂初死未久位。又死魔業名時運盡。此死略義者：謂若死、若死法、若死差別、若死後位，是名略義。如是名為緣起差別應知。
items.en: What is the relinquishing of every aggregate as the life-faculty itself passes away? Dying when one's time has fully come. What is death by misfortune? Dying out of season, through some untimely circumstance. What is the aggregates' expiring in time? The stage immediately after death has just occurred; it is also called the working of the lord of death. The essential meaning of death is this: death itself, the manner of dying, death's own varieties, and the stage following death — this is its essential meaning. This, then, is what is meant by the differences of dependent origination.

blocks.text: Fascicle 10 completes the account of dependent origination, and with it the three grounds of thought begun in fascicle 4. Today: the last five links, from craving to old age and death, each defined in detail. The descriptions of old age and death are unsentimental and precise; read them slowly as contemplation.

**Craving** (愛) is of three kinds, by realm: a defiled longing for the formations of the desire, form, or formless realm, producing that realm's suffering. Master Cháng Bǎi: longing for liberation is not one of them; it is "the love of renunciation", undefiled and not bound up with ignorance. (Day 72 returns to this point.)

**Grasping** (取) is of four kinds: grasping at sense desires, at views, at precepts and vows, and at **self-doctrine** (我語取), which is "craving directed at the view of a perishable self". Venerable Miào Jìng explains the word 語 ("speech") in the name: "This 'self' is only a word, an empty phrase; one says 'I', but really there is none." Grasping at precepts includes practising only to be reborn in heaven, as with the cow and dog vows (Day 51); Venerable Miào Jìng adds that meditating merely for a heavenly rebirth is the same.

**Becoming** (有) is looked at from seven angles: the ordinary span of a life, the karma that projects it, death, the intermediate state, rebirth, and existence in the five destinies. The form realm excludes the lower destinies and humans; the formless realm also excludes the intermediate state, because, Venerable Miào Jìng explains, the intermediate state is material.

These kinds serve three functions: projecting (karmic becoming), heading towards a destiny (the intermediate state), and experiencing a result (the destinies themselves). Venerable Miào Jìng: strictly, the "becoming" of the twelve links is karmic becoming alone, the moistened seed of Day 65.

**Birth** (生) is described from the first instant in the womb onwards: conception, emergence, appearance (for moisture-born and spontaneously born beings, the body appearing at once), arising, the attainment of the elements and sense-bases, and a sustained life-faculty. Master Cháng Bǎi: the aggregates are nourished daily by the four foods. Venerable Miào Jìng tells of the monk Zhìzàng, who was told by a physiognomist that his life was ending, recited the *Diamond Sūtra*, and lived on: lifespan is karma, and karma can change.

**Old age** (老) is portrayed in seventeen details: hair losing its colour, skin wrinkling, frailty, a bent back, trembling limbs, a failing constitution, a weakening memory. Master Cháng Bǎi, citing the *Vibhāṣā*: even noble ones from stream-enterers to pratyekabuddhas grow white hair; only the Buddha has no such sign.

One detail is "**decline**": "mindfulness and wisdom so weakened that wholesome practice can no longer even be undertaken." This is the practical warning of the passage. Venerable Miào Jìng, citing the *Vibhāṣā*, says arhats at the end of life enter concentration to test themselves: the body has declined, but has the path? For the rest of us, the warning is to practise while we can.

**Death** (死) is described in nine stages, including "expiring", when the joints come apart. Master Cháng Bǎi: at death "a wind arises that cuts the joints like a knife". Death may be timely, when the life-faculty runs out, or untimely. The aggregates' ending is called "the working of the Māra of death". Master Cháng Bǎi: Māra, because when a life ends the path it might have walked is cut off. This completes the twelve links one by one.

quiz.q: Does longing for supreme liberation count among the three cravings, according to Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: no — it is renunciant longing, undefiled and not bound up with ignorance
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: "There is a kind of love not associated with a defiled mind, not bound up with ignorance — the love of renunciation, longing for supreme liberation." The three cravings are all "defiled longing," so this lies outside them; §22 likewise says it is not conditioned by feeling.

quiz.q: According to the treatise, what is the grasping of self-doctrine?
options: craving directed at the view of a perishable self
craving for precepts from a wrong aspiration
quiz.why: "What is the grasping of self-doctrine? Craving directed at the view of a perishable self itself." The grasping of views is craving for every other view. B is sensual grasping, C grasping of precepts. "The first alone produces suffering only in the desire realm; the remaining three … throughout all three realms."

quiz.q: Why does 我語取 contain the word 語 ("speech")? How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain it?
options: this "self" is just a word, an empty phrase — one says "I," but there is no self
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "This 'self' is only a word, an empty phrase — one says 'I,' 'there is a self,' but really there is none." Grasping of self-doctrine is found in all ordinary beings, Buddhist or not, whereas grasping of views and of precepts mostly belongs to non-Buddhists.

quiz.q: According to the treatise, on what three functions are the seven kinds of becoming established?
options: projecting (karmic becoming), heading towards a destiny (intermediate state), and experiencing a result (the five destinies)
quiz.why: "On the basis of three distinct functions. First, the projecting function, belonging to karmic becoming alone. Second, the function of heading towards a destiny, belonging to the intermediate state alone. Third, the function of actually experiencing a result, belonging to the five destinies."

quiz.q: Of all these kinds of becoming, which does the twelve-link chain's "becoming" refer to, per Venerable Miào Jìng?
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "Strictly speaking, the 'becoming' in the twelve links is karmic becoming alone." He adds that the ordinary interval is resultant existence, while karmic becoming is causal existence.

quiz.q: According to the treatise, what is "decline" (衰退)?
options: mindfulness and wisdom so weak that wholesome practice can no longer be undertaken
quiz.why: "Mindfulness and wisdom so weakened that wholesome practice can no longer even be undertaken." Venerable Miào Jìng, citing the *Pixunji*: weakness of mindfulness and wisdom is "decline," and faith and other good qualities failing to appear is "retreat" — so practice while young.

quiz.q: What is "the joints coming apart," according to Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: at death a wind arises that cuts the joints like a knife — the "knife wind" — severing skin, flesh, sinew, and bone
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: "When a person is about to die, a wind arises that cuts the joints like a knife — the 'knife wind,' also called joint-dissolving — severing skin, flesh, sinew, bone, marrow, and blood," "as painful as a turtle shedding its shell."
